plan.summary: BRO-4910 (follow-up): finish the Into the Woods 2022 cleanup. Give the Observer and NYT reviews their real critics' filenames (David Cote, Alexis Soloski) and drop the duplicate NYT copy; re-credit the Front Mezz Junkies review to Steven Ross (the page byline) with its 2022-07-28 date so a refetch can score it.
steps: File already credits David Cote (url observer.com/2022/07/review-into-the-woods-still-casts-a-sensational-spell-on-broadway/, page byline David Cote) but is named for Jesse Green, who never wrote for the Observer. Renamed so the filename matches the byline and no later re-derive credits Green again.

Byte-identical copy of the NYT review text (same url nytimes.com/2022/07/10/theater/into-the-woods-review.html), currently duplicateOf nytimes--jesse-green.json. Deleted so the one real copy can take the correct Soloski filename in the next action.

The NYT review at nytimes.com/2022/07/10/theater/into-the-woods-review.html is by Alexis Soloski (criticName already Soloski, score 90 kept). Renamed off the Jesse Green filename so Soloski is the canonical file, not a duplicate of a Green file.

Live page fetched 2026-10-19 reads 'The Broadway Theatre Review: Into the Woods By Ross' and the author link is 'View all posts by ross'. Ross is Front Mezz Junkies' founder Steven Ross (critic-registry steven-ross, primaryOutlet frontmezzjunkies; 109 FMJ files credit him). Nothing on the page names Shannon Shyne.
article:published_time on the page is 2022-07-28T14:54:00+00:00 (also the date in the url).
Rename to match the corrected byline. The file stays a stub (no text) until ingest-urls.yml refetches the url, which merges into this file by url match and gets it scored.
